before: ATV rental and tour companies owe a duty of reasonable care to their customers under both Georgia and South Carolina negligence law. Georgia's general negligence statute and premises liability principles under O.C.G.A. § 51-3-1 require businesses to maintain safe conditions and adequately warn of known hazards. South Carolina imposes similar duties under common law negligence principles. Commercial ATV operations must also comply with O.C.G.A. § 40-7-120 (Georgia) and S.C. Code § 56-15-10 (South Carolina) governing off-highway vehicle operation.
after: ATV rental and tour companies owe a duty of reasonable care to their customers under both Georgia and South Carolina negligence law. Georgia's general negligence statute and premises liability principles under O.C.G.A. § 51-3-1 require businesses to maintain safe conditions and adequately warn of known hazards. South Carolina imposes similar duties under common law negligence principles. Commercial ATV operations must also comply with Georgia's off-road vehicle law (O.C.G.A. § 40-7-1 et seq.) and South Carolina's ATV law (S.C. Code § 50-26-10 et seq.).
